{
  "name": "clocks-band",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A band above the prompt showing every Bash command, MCP call and subagent that has run for a while, with elapsed time against its limit.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Naren",
    "url": "https://github.com/NarenDawar"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/NarenDawar/narens-claude-toolkit/tree/main/plugins/clocks-band",
  "repository": "https://github.com/NarenDawar/narens-claude-toolkit",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-mods",
    "timers",
    "subagents"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "minSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Show after (seconds)",
      "description": "A call or subagent gets a row once it has run this long.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 600
    },
    "maxRows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Most rows",
      "description": "Rows shown before '+N more'.",
      "default": 4,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 20
    },
    "subagentWarnMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Subagent warn time (minutes)",
      "description": "A subagent row is marked OVER past this time. Advisory: the mod stops nothing.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 1440
    },
    "mcpWarnSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "MCP call warn time (seconds)",
      "description": "An MCP call row is marked OVER past this time. Advisory: the mod stops nothing.",
      "default": 120,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 86400
    },
    "bashDefaultLimitSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Limit shown for a Bash call with no timeout (seconds)",
      "description": "0 shows no limit for a Bash call that carries no timeout of its own.",
      "default": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600
    }
  }
}
